name: workflowers-cancellations-to-scw-unblock

deploy.description: Deletion propagation for the two-way calendar-blocking pair. workflowers-events-to-scw-busy's event_updated trigger runs with expand_recurring: true, and in that mode Zapier silently drops cancellations (proven 2026-08-31: the meeting-note Zap on expand_recurring: false had 13 cancelled tombstones in its last 100 runs; the blocking Zap had 0 in 100, and a deleted 9am work.flowers event left its SCW Busy block standing). This slim workflow triggers on event_cancelled for dennis@work.flowers, looks the cancelled event up in the GCal Sync Map, deletes its SCW Busy block, and marks the row deleted. Creates and updates stay with the main Zap.

trigger.authentication_note: work.flowers Google Calendar connection ('Google Calendar dennis@work.flowers') — the calendar whose cancellations are read. The SCW credential is a --connections alias because this workflow deletes Busy blocks there.
trigger.trigger_note: Polling trigger, fires on cancellation/deletion. `calendarid` is its only input field (verified via list-trigger-input-fields 2026-08-31). Payload is the raw Google event with status 'cancelled', per-occurrence ids for recurring instances — the probe on 2026-08-31 contained the exact deleted 9am event that motivated this Zap.
trigger.why_this_exists: event_updated with expand_recurring: true NEVER delivers cancellations — the trigger_note on workflowers-events-to-scw-busy originally bet the other way based on the meeting-note Zap's behaviour, but that Zap runs expand_recurring: false, which turned out to be the deciding difference. First observed live 2026-08-31: a deleted 9am work.flowers event left its SCW Busy block standing until it was cleared by hand-triggering the main Zap's cancel path.

connections_note: gcal_scw is the SCW Google Calendar connection 'dchiuten@securecodewarrior.com' — where this workflow deletes the Busy blocks that workflowers-events-to-scw-busy / gcal-block-sweep created.

tables.01M13QPJ5GRJV33096MBNSN1Q5: GCal Sync Map — shared with the whole blocking family. Read for the loop guard (a cancelled event whose id is a Mirror Event ID is the sync's own deletion echoing back) and the mapping lookup; the matched row's Status is written to 'deleted'.

description: work.flowers calendar cancellations → delete the corresponding private Busy block on the SCW calendar and mark the GCal Sync Map row deleted. The deletion-propagation half event_updated (expand_recurring: true) cannot deliver.
